title: Superb Warfare expanded
description: Modern military modpack featuring realistic guns, vehicles, helicopters, tanks, and immersive tactical combat.
body:
Superb Warfare Expanded is a military-focused Minecraft modpack featuring modern weapons, vehicles, aircraft, artillery and engineering. ## The main focus is combat and military gameplay, but the pack also gives you room to build your own bases, factories and infrastructure. Mods like Superb Warfare, TACZ, Create and Create Big Cannons work together to add weapons, vehicles, artillery and engineering without completely changing the feel of Minecraft. ![T-90A tank in Superb Warfare Expanded](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7db71c64e32344e403a5abc8dce3cfd594d9ff1d_0.webp) ## What is included * Modern firearms and equipment * Tanks and other armored vehicles * Aircraft and helicopters * Artillery and heavy weapons * Military bases and structures * Create and Create Big Cannons * Terrain and exploration improvements (Terralith on 1.20.1) * Xaero's Minimap and World Map * Simple Voice Chat * Performance and optimization mods ## Gameplay You can play on your own or with friends. Build a base, prepare your equipment, set up production and take your vehicles into combat. The pack is built around open-ended military gameplay, so there is no single way to play it. You can focus on infantry combat, build and operate vehicles, work on your own military base, or use Create to build production and artillery systems. In multiplayer you can gather your squad, capture strategic locations, take part in large-scale battles, construct bases and combine infantry, vehicles and aircraft. ## Forge vs NeoForge The pack is available on both **Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge** and **Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge**, but the two versions are not identical. ### **1.21.1 (NeoForge): Main Branch** This is the main branch of the pack and the version where long-term development is focused. It was moved to NeoForge because most upstream mods no longer support Forge on newer Minecraft versions. NeoForge also has access to performance mods such as **Lithium and Sodium**, which are used in this branch and are not part of the 1.20.1 Forge setup. The main downside is content availability. Some TACZ addons and other military modules have not been ported to NeoForge yet, so the 1.21.1 version currently has a smaller selection of weapons, attachments and related content. Some components also rely on community ports while official NeoForge support is still unavailable. ### **1.20.1 (Forge): Full Content** This version currently has the larger selection of military content and addons, especially TACZ content, attachments and other military-related addons. New updates usually arrive on 1.20.1 first. **Choose 1.21.1 NeoForge if you want the main branch, the newer Minecraft version and the additional performance options. Choose 1.20.1 Forge if you want the larger content set and the earliest updates.** ## Mod lists
Mod list 1.21.1 ### Minecraft 1.21.1 - NeoForge **Military & Combat** * Superb Warfare * TACZ **Create & Technology** * Create **Performance & Optimization** * Lithium * Sodium * FerriteCore * ModernFix * Entity Culling * More Culling * Dynamic FPS * ImmediatelyFast * Clumps **Interface & Quality of Life** * Jade * BetterF3 * Xaero's Minimap * Xaero's World Map * Simple Voice Chat * Continuity **Compatibility & Libraries** * Forgified Fabric API * Sinytra Connector * Curios API * Cloth Config API * Kotlin for Forge * GeckoLib * YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)

## Technical Information * **Minecraft:** 1.21.1 NeoForge / 1.20.1 Forge * **Java:** 21 for 1.21.1, 17 for 1.20.1 * **RAM:** 4 GB minimum, 6-8 GB recommended * **Storage:** 8 GB+ free space * **CPU:** 4+ cores recommended * **GPU:** Dedicated GPU recommended * **Performance:** Older or low-end PCs may experience FPS drops and longer loading times. * **Multiplayer:** Clients and servers must use the same pack version and loader. ## License **MIT License** Copyright (c) 2026 Simon This license applies to the original content of the modpack "Superb Warfare Expanded", which includes configuration files, scripts, documentation, and other proprietary materials created by the modpack author. **This modpack contains third-party mods that are distributed under their own licenses.** These mods are not affected by this license, and their use is governed by the terms specified on their authors' websites. ##
FAQ **Is it multiplayer compatible?** Yes. The pack can be used for multiplayer gameplay and servers.
## Development The pack is actively being developed. New weapons, vehicles, structures, optimizations and gameplay improvements are planned for future updates. ## **Rate Superb Warfare Expanded** Enjoying the pack?
